description:
Get Yellow Pages Place Details

Scrapes a single YellowPages business listing URL and returns business name, street address, city, region, zip code, coordinates, phone, website, hours of operation, payment methods, categories, ratings, review counts, photos, and service descriptions, plus email and years in business on yellowpages.com listings. Fields the listing does not publish, such as a street address, hours, or email, are omitted from the response. Use to hydrate a lead with verified NAP data, build a B2B contact database from YellowPages URLs collected via the Search endpoint, or validate business legitimacy and hours before outreach.

url.description: The YellowPages URL of the place.
